extDescription.message: Delete all unpinned Gemini chat messages and clean up history

customShortcutDesc.message: Pick the shortcut you want to use when deleting conversations inside Gemini.

customShortcutHintRecord.message: Recording now. Press Escape to cancel.

customShortcutHintIdle.message: Press Enter to record a new shortcut.

showTrashIcon.message: Show delete button in chat list

showTrashIconDesc.message: Add a visible delete button to each Gemini conversation for faster one-click cleanup.

skipConfirmationDesc.message: Delete immediately without Gemini's confirmation popup. Recommended for faster cleanup.

bulkDeleteShortcutDesc.message: Delete all unpinned chats in Recent. Pinned chats are always kept.

bulkDeleteShortcutHintRecord.message: Recording now. Press Escape to cancel.

deleteUnpinnedNowDesc.message: Start bulk deletion on the current Gemini tab. Press Escape to stop.
